commit.message:
fix(bazel): avoid canonical repository names in unit scopes (#1274)

Replaces hardcoded canonical labels (`@@//...`,
`@@score_baselibs+//...`) in rules_score unit scopes with apparent names
(buildifier `canonical-repository`). Split out of #1255.
